name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1484: Konyo asked that everyone start fresh except the MacBook, with chronicles and forges at 0/0. That promise has been enforced by hand until now: v1469 wrote the rule, v1478 fixed the console ignoring it, and both were verified by launching the app and reading numbers off a screen. TestAFreshMachineStartsEmpty boots the REAL bible.html in a virgin browser profile, lets it run its own first-boot path, then reopens the same profile on a probe page to read what was actually written to disk. It asserts the machine derived itself as windows with source auto, that the published route matches the world it is in, that the W-dot chronicle keys are all empty, and that the owner bare namespace was never touched. Mutation-verified: removing the cousin-shell guard from the grail seed makes a never-used machine boot with 351 pre-seeded grail finds, and the test names the number. This is the test that would have caught REG-076 without a user report.
